title: A five-qubit 1-resistant graph state and stabilizer marginal certificates
summary: We study particle-loss resistant entanglement within the framework of stabilizer and graph states. A pure state is \(m\)-resistant if it remains entangled after the loss of any \(m\) particles and becomes fully separable after the loss of any \(m+1\) particles. The smallest previously unresolved qubit case was the existence of a five-qubit \(1\)-resistant pure state, which is resolved here by the five-cycle graph state \(\ket{C_5}\).
